coverage.note: Adaptive invocation groups; this is a sampled/aggregated dataset, not an individual invocation or per-tick census. Long-lived WebSocket rows are aggregated by connection lifetime.

interpretation.internalErrors: The two internalError groups coincide with the controlled restarts. They are lifecycle artefacts of forced runtime restarts, not simulation or serialization errors; the room diagnostics recorded zero tick, persistence and serialization failures.
interpretation.clientDisconnects: responseStreamDisconnected and clientDisconnected correspond to the forced socket closures. They are not CPU measurements.
interpretation.cpu: The invocation rows contain percentile CPU per adaptive group, not a per-tick timeline. No value is used as individual-tick CPU evidence.
